params.prompt: Educational animation reference diagram, clean black line art with graphite shading on white. Title at top: "What Actually Produces a Smear". TWO panels side by side. LEFT panel headed "ONE-WAY MOVE — no smear" with a red X: a cartoon arm reaching straight sideways from A to B in a single direction, three clean drawings, no blur, labelled "a single translation stays crisp". RIGHT panel headed "REPEATED or ROTATING — smear" with a green check: the same arm whipping back and forth across the same distance, drawn with a long streaked drybrush smear frame between the extremes, plus a second small example of a spinning body with a circular smear ring around it. Callouts: "reverses direction", "rotates through the arc", "smear frame lives here — 1 frame". Footer: "Ask for a repeat or a rotation. A one-way reach will not smear no matter how it is described.". No other text.
